rules: Official organizer sources prioritized; secondary sources are clearly marked provisional.
Do not carry historic GPX/routes into 2027 without edition-specific binary retrieval and complete track parsing.
A map/video/download control is not equivalent to a parsed binary GPX.
No live records, app runtime or old GPX files are changed in this audit.
